- CHUNKING_MODEL=${LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
  # Vision / multimodal (modul-inhaltsextraktion: VLM enhancement + LightOnOCR):
  - VLLM_MODEL=${LITELLM_VISUAL_MODEL}
  - LIGHT_ON_OCR_MODEL=${LITELLM_VISUAL_MODEL}

processes:
  project-logic:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18000 --reload
    working_dir: ./02-backend/project_logic_service
    environment:
      - DB_NAME=project_logic
      - TEMPORAL__HOST=localhost:7233
      - TEMPORAL__TASK_QUEUE=project-logic-service
      - TEMPORAL__NAMESPACE=default
      - TEMPORAL__S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_REGION=eu-west-1
      - API__ADMINISTRATIVE_FILE_DRAFT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18010
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 18000
        path: /docs
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  project-logic-seed:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python -m src.scripts.seed_data
    working_dir: ./02-backend/project_logic_service
    environment:
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
    depends_on:
      project-logic:
        condition: process_healthy

  document-management:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18001 --reload
    working_dir: ./02-backend/document_management_service
    environment:
      - DB_NAME=dms
      # Origin embedded in presigned upload/download URLs handed to the browser. Overrides the
      # service's .env.local. Same-origin as the frontend behind a reverse proxy; localhost otherwise.
      - S3_EXTERNAL_URL=${S3_PUBLIC_URL}
      - TEMPORAL__HOST=localhost:7233
      - TEMPORAL__TASK_QUEUE=dms
      - TEMPORAL__PLS_TASK_QUEUE=project-logic-service
      - TEMPORAL__NAMESPACE=default
      - TEMPORAL__S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_REGION=eu-west-1
      - TEMPORAL__ENABLE_APPROVAL=false
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
